programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Glitch tries to teach the Grimbots by drawing on a chalkboard. Before he can finish, his last piece of chalk snaps and the grumpy Grandmaster demands the Grimbots find a fresh supply. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters arrive at the White Cliffs of Dover in England, to cheer Kyan as he finishes a cross-Channel swim, but a large cloud of dust blocks his way to the shore. On the beach, Lars and Foz find the Grimbots mining the cliffs with a big drill, causing a big crack to spread across the rock face. Can they cut the power and make the cliffs safe again?

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When a very sleepy Tommy Brock is hoisted up into the Squirrel Camp, Peter and friends must work out how to get the snoozing brute back down to earth before he wakes up!

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Join Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers, The Octonauts, for more deep sea adventures. The Octonauts roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. Whether it's a perilous voyage to the bottom of the sea or the piratey pursuit of a giant squid, the Octonauts leap into action and always prove that eight heads are better than one. While exploring a dark and spooky cave, the Octonauts discover the fossil of a powerful, prehistoric fish... but it may be more than just a fossil.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: It’s time for some bouncy fun as the Numberblobs take over the show. Learn about number lines, comparing numbers and more with the Numberblobs.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. B the bassist and her brother D the drummer get new guitarist N to join the band, but they still need a singer. They try auditioning the vowels but make some strange sounds before the band is complete.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The Piris agree to mind a package for Shirley but discover it’s a precious egg! Watching over Eggy turns out to be exhausting, but then Shirley returns with unexpected news.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: The doctors realise Fergus's bog mud has healing properties. Fergus starts to feel overwhelmed when they send everyone to the bog for treatment.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo have to carry Jackson’s big blue 'chicken' Ludwig (who definitely isn’t a chicken) to the country fair. But the easily-startled bird gets away from them - the chase is on!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: 'Eggy got broken and I didn't want that to happen.' At Amma's creche the children make eggy heads with egg shells and cress seeds. Bing knows his Eggy needs water, light and time before it can grow 'hair' but waiting is hard. He tries to speed up the process by giving Eggy lots of water with the garden hose.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘clock’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of clocks – square, round, one with numbers and one that makes a really loud sound! We see Dee watching the clock when her train is late and a little clock and their grandfather! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: It's bedtime for Maddie and Triggs, but when a rogue fly buzzes in through Maddie's bedroom window, it's not so easy to fall asleep. Triggs and Dad try their own unique methods of dealing with this uninvited, buzzy house guest, but Maddie reminds them to listen more carefully.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Fiona asks the Piggies to help transport her pumpkin to the Vegetable Festival. They agree, but the pumpkin is so big, it's nearly impossible. The Piggies will have to turn it into a carriage!

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos watch a man practising his tennis strokes using a machine to shoot the balls to him. Once all the balls have been fired by the machine, the man collects up the balls and refills the machine, setting the dial to start again. Great BigHoo turns the dial and the balls come out faster and faster. The Robot visits the Twirlywoos on The Big Red Boat. Great BigHoo turns the key on the Robot's head who then runs away fast. Toodloo turns the key and makes the robot run faster. Chickedy and Chick turn the key and the robot runs faster and faster. Can the Twirlywoos catch him?

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friend take a day trip on a horse-drawn canal boat, while Mr Tumble and Tumble Ted are heading to the seaside in the Tumble Car – if he remembers how to start it!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Laa-Laa makes up a lovely song about all of the things she sees on her walk across Teletubbyland. Afterwards, she sings a song to Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po. They sing the song together and watch a children's choir sing in Tummy Tales.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Isobel, Idris, Lincoln, Amber, Amelia, Jason, Willow and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are Pans which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate pans inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun song ‘Five Fat Sausages’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: In Tall Trees Forest, Lisa and a group of children make pretend cakes, learn British Sign Language signs for pat, cake and baby, and sing and sign the rhyme Pat-a-Cake.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron, Joda, Nelly and Noah find out some of the clever ways water helps the garden, from being used to clean paths to giving birds somewhere to bathe.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: The young rhinos play a noticing game and spot lots of lovely things. Hamza sees some playful vervet monkeys and feeds Zuri the eland delicious leaves.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Pania, Kiri and Lou visit the hot springs.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey's backyard zoo is home to wonderful animals, especially the big blue daddy gorilla. But when he grabs visitor Bingo and escapes, zookeeper Bluey must recapture the wild beast.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee is going to make the Squirrels juice from fresh fruit in the garden. Whilst picking the fruit, the Squirrels meet a little bug, full of woes about being too small. The Squirrels think it must be brilliant to be so tiny but the little bug disagrees.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Red and Yellow try to make a bright orange colour like their good friend Orange.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Tahira wants to find out all about water voles in today’s episode. Chantelle heads up the river with some friends looking for signs of water voles, and Rory meets an expert on them in the city. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files help answer all of Tahira questions. With the help of the Teeny Tiny Creatures poem, we discover that, like lots of other teeny tiny creatures, water voles are superheroes and help our planet in their own special way. In the Teeny Tiny Task, Chantelle and the children create water vole masks.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Eden and Ava set up a beauty salon and make their very own face mask mixture. Dad pops along for a beauty treatment, but will his visit leave him feeling relaxed? Later, the family heads to the park for a game of hide-and-seek, and a cheeky squirrel decides to join in the fun.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Children’s cookery series with Big Cook Jen and Little Cook Small. Jen is a rock star in the cafe today, but Small is too small to play any of the instruments. Meanwhile, Busy the Bee visits the cafe for a speedy snack and leaves them the perfect gift.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Kika and her family are off to the seaside. Since they’ll be travelling by bus, she and Dr Amit will need to work together to find the way, using the map on Amit’s phone and Kika’s super sight. Once she learns a new route, she stores it in her memory bank. She knows 300 routes already - Kika is like a doggy GPS! Using her waymarks, including a magic picture that turns people into lobsters, a talkative bucket and spade and a giant pile of stinky seaweed, Kika successfully guides her family to the beach. But when they stop for some delicious fish and chips on the way back, Amit and Seema realise Anoushka has left her jacket on the beach. Kika calls on her super sight to retrace her steps with Amit. But will she find their way again? And can she and Amit get back to the bus stop to meet their family before the bus leaves for home? The race is on.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: It’s Silas and his classmates' first full day at school! There are lots of things to explore, new friends to make and teachers to meet. After meeting the teachers, the children explore the classroom and outdoor area. At lunchtime, Ottilie and Bryn ‘spot’ an invisible mouse in the dining hall. Lusungu finds that opening yogurt lids can be a bit tricky. Luckily, Mrs Farrell is on hand to help. The day continues as Silas and Maily create family portraits. Silas has fun drawing his mum's, but finds it harder to draw his pet cats - so he draws rabbits instead!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: When Jess takes Evie for her first school visit, Waffle goes along too - on the condition that he doesn't sing. He tries his best to behave, but it's hard for a Wonder Dog! On their walk to school, Jess and Evie bump into Connie Lester and her daughter Ruby. Ruby reveals that she will also be starting at Sommersby School too, in the year above Evie. Ruby enjoys stroking Waffle and tells Evie that she loves animals. She has a pet dog of her own, Jelly, a yellow labrador. Waffle introduces himself to Jelly, but decides Jelly is a grumpy dog. Meanwhile, there's a For Sale sign in Mrs Hobbs' front garden. Mrs Hobbs and George are moving house and leaving Maple Close forever.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Marvin, Oona and Silky are playing hide-and-seek in the Underwater Cave. Silky tries lots of different hiding places but gets frustrated when Oona and Marvin find her easily. When it's her turn to look for her friends, Silky is slow on land and is disappointed when she can't find her friends. But when she agrees to play once more, Silky finds a hiding place that's just right for her!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Yukee enjoys the peace and quiet in the garden when she wakes up early. But she soon discovers that while it might be quiet, the garden is never silent.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are out for a walk with Granny when they hear some interesting sounds coming from an old bell tower, and before long, they make friends with Ding, Dong, Bing and Bong - four creaky singing bells in need of some help!

programme.desc: The Piggies decide to help Keith play with his ball, but their failed attempts lead to more and more repairs for the neighbours. Things get so bad that Wilf ends up confiscating the ball. Keith isn't allowed to play any more? Now, that is impossible!
